note: Export side is factually confirmed: at least 5 dated customs export records Oct 2025 - Feb 2026, product 'Spray Dried Chicory Blend 90Q', HS 21013090, ex-Mundra/Hazira (Gujarat) to Gdansk (Poland/Ukraine consignee). Domestic status therefore recorded as unknown, not as 'none_found', because the absence is a retrieval failure rather than a verified absence. Revenue and export volume figures are not public on the free views — left null, not estimated. Registry/catalogue data deliberately not used as evidence. No rejection grounds: entity appears active in customs records through Feb 2026.
